verdict.rationale: Meltano officially provides the Meltano SDK for Singer Connectors (and EDK for Meltano Components) for building custom extractors/loaders, and community feedback corroborates a positive hands-on experience building a custom tap with it. However, evidence lacks deeper SDK reference docs, versioning, or language-support specifics beyond the docs/homepage mention. missing for 10: detailed SDK API reference, version/compatibility docs, broader independent corroboration beyond one HN comment.
